'''''Ophrys omegaifera''''', the '''omega bee-orchid''', is a species of [[orchid]]<ref>Fleischmann, Andreas. 1925.  Oesterreichische Botanische Zeitschrift 74: 184</ref> native to the [[Mediterranean]] region from [[Portugal]] and [[Morocco]] to [[Syria]].<ref name="asd93q456agr">[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=141544 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref>

==Subspecies and varieties==
Numerous subspecific and varietal names have been proposed. {{As of|2023|December}}, [[Plants of the World Online]] accepted the following:<ref name=POWO_648034-1>{{Cite POWO|title=''Ophrys omegaifera'' H.Fleischm..|id=648034-1|access-date=2023-12-13|mode=cs1}}</ref>
*''Ophrys omegaifera'' var. ''basilissa'' <small>(C.Alibertis, A.Alibertis & H.R.Reinhard) Faurh</small> - Greece
*''Ophrys omegaifera'' subsp. ''dyris'' <small>(Maire) Del Prete</small> - Spain, Portugal, Morocco, Balearic Islands
*''Ophrys omegaifera'' subsp. ''fleischmannii'' <small>(Hayek) Del Prete</small> - Crete and other Greek islands
*''Ophrys omegaifera'' subsp. ''hayekii'' <small>(H.Fleischm. & Soó) Kreutz</small> - Sicily, Algeria, Tunisia
*''Ophrys omegaifera'' subsp. ''israelitica'' <small>(H.Baumann & Künkele) G.Morschek & K.Morschek</small> - Palestine region, Lebanon-Syria, Turkey, Cyprus, Greece 
*[[Ophrys omegaifera subsp. omegaifera|''Ophrys omegaifera'' subsp. ''omegaifera'']] (synonyms include ''Ophrys apollonae'' <small>Paulus & M.Hirth</small>) - Turkey, Greek islands
